**标准材料（SQL 的 gold 结果为已实际执行保存结果）**

{
  "definition": {
    "id": "repeat_customer_count",
    "name": "期间内复购客户数",
    "grain": "customer within explicitly given period",
    "expression": "COUNT of customers with COUNT(invoice_id) >= 2 in period",
    "empty_behavior": "0 when no qualifying customers",
    "limitation": "Invoice records are not evidence of successful payment; crossing period bounds is not inferred"
  },
  "general_rules": {
    "date_field": "invoice.invoice_date",
    "period": "Half-open [start_date, end_date); no missing period is silently filled",
    "region": "customer.country is customer residence; invoice.billing_country is invoice billing address; equality in current snapshot does not merge meanings",
    "unit": "Database amount unit; no inferred USD/CNY or payment status",
    "zero_denominator": "Return null and explain unavailable denominator"
  },
  "readonly_sql_example": {
    "id": "repeat_customers",
    "sql": "SELECT COUNT(*) AS repeat_customer_count FROM (SELECT customer_id FROM public.invoice WHERE invoice_date >= DATE '2024-01-01' AND invoice_date < DATE '2025-01-01' GROUP BY customer_id HAVING COUNT(*) >= 2) AS repeat_customers;",
    "status": "executed",
    "columns": [
      "repeat_customer_count"
    ],
    "rows": [

  },
  "general_rules": {
    "date_field": "invoice.invoice_date",

    "region": "customer.country is customer residence; invoice.billing_country is invoice billing address; equality in current snapshot does not merge meanings",
    "unit": "Database amount unit; no inferred USD/CNY or payment status",

  "readonly_sql_example": {
    "id": "popular_tracks",

<a id="nl2sql"></a>

## 单表 SQL 标准与实际回答（50 题）

| 编号 | 分组 | 问题 / 候选 | 状态 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| [sql-01](#nl2sql-sql-01) | dev | 客户表共有多少位客户？ | pending_human_review |
| [sql-02](#nl2sql-sql-02) | dev | 来自巴西的客户有多少位？ | pending_human_review |
| [sql-03](#nl2sql-sql-03) | holdout | 曲目表中时长超过 5 分钟的曲目有多少首？ | pending_human_review |
| [sql-04](#nl2sql-sql-04) | dev | 列出来自巴西的客户编号、名字、姓氏和城市，按客户编号升序。 | pending_human_review |
| [sql-05](#nl2sql-sql-05) | dev | 列出来自美国的客户编号、城市和州，按客户编号升序。 | pending_human_review |
| [sql-06](#nl2sql-sql-06) | dev | 列出单价高于 0.99 的前 10 首曲目的编号、名称和单价，按曲目编号升序。 | pending_human_review |

  "answer": "曲目最受欢迎的默认口径是沿用总计划的购买数量默认，即 SUM(invoice_line.quantity) [E1]。汇总表达式中，热门曲目（统计粒度为期间内曲目）的核心表达式为 SUM(invoice_line.quantity) [E2]。",

        "四项指标的定义与限制",
        "热门曲目"
      ],
      "text": "热门曲目\n曲目最受欢迎沿用总计划的购买数量默认，即 SUM(invoice_line.quantity)。按销售额或按歌单收录数属于明确的备选口径，不能凭当前排名相同而互换。\n附录中的客户谁买得最多保留金额口径；没有查询对象的短语不套同一个全局默认。并列时以 track_id 升序稳定排序。D2登记口径，不提前实现 D3 完整澄清分级或口径切换。",

      ],
      "text": "指标对应关系\n指标全名 | 统计粒度 | 核心表达式\n发票销售额 | 发票 | SUM(invoice.total)\n平均每张发票金额 | 发票 | AVG(invoice.total)\n期间内复购客户数 | 期间内客户 | 发票数至少2张的客户数\n热门曲目 | 期间内曲目 | SUM(invoice_line.quantity)\n机器可读规则保存在 data/rules/metric_definitions.json。口径审核与每一道评测题的 gold 人工审核分别记录，互不替代。",
